question: Can an amortized globally consistent complex response representation predict withheld experimental diffraction better than coherent reconstruction and flexible measurement heads under the same observations?
roles_reason: Group all possibly related sample scans; two pattern/circuit training families, a separate pattern validation family, two battery-material families held for final assessment. Chosen using provenance and geometry, before query errors.

input.initial_object: Frozen standard v1 LSQML epoch1000 from permitted visible frames, never full-scan references. Every learned control receives the same input.
input.global_features: Visible-fluence-normalized complex object; log amplitude, two nearest-neighbor phase products (real/imag), relative coverage, preconditioned visible intensity-gradient real/imag, budget fraction. All phase invariant.
input.calibration: Given full-scan estimated probe and canvas/parity geometry. Conditional calibration-assisted setting. No independent probe recovery or clean-noise theorem claimed for the archive.
input.intensity_scaling: alpha = 1/sqrt(mean_visible(I^2)), without rounding. x0=object/sqrt(mean_visible(sum I)/sum|probe|^2); Ptilde=probe*sqrt(mean_visible(sum I)/sum|probe|^2)*sqrt(alpha). Physical normalized predictions equal alpha*I.
input.query_values: Excluded from predictor input, normalization, early stopping of iterative baselines, and target-source model choice.

labels.train: For each input budget: all frames outside visible_ids and outside the already fixed query_ids, within W/IC1/IC2 only. These are raw detector values, not object references.
labels.validation: Fixed query_ids in TP1 and TP2; used only for checkpoint selection after contract freeze.
labels.validation_stress: FLY1 query values remain unopened until model checkpoints are locked; shown separately, no selection.
labels.test: LFP and NCM fixed query_ids remain unopened until all learned seeds/controls and iterative baseline5000 are complete and the final assessment manifest is frozen.
labels.unused_train_query: Fixed20% query_ids in training scans remain diagnostic-only and unopened during fitting; not required for optimization.

models.primary: moment: shared whole-canvas CNN -> one corrected complex field plus four global residual fields; sum of propagated squared moduli
models.coherent: Same CNN trunk and training data; one corrected complex field, native intensity readout
models.direct: Same five-field CNN, same query field propagation, then a shared positive nonlinear detector-space head with powers, complex cross terms and detector coordinates. More flexible than a PSD-linear readout; parameter overhead recorded.
models.simple_controls: Unmodified LSQML100/300/1000 and new5000; public fixed PtychoPINN primarycrop64 (crop10retained); nearest/IDW4/IDW16; one training-fitted shared intensity scale on the1000input prediction.
models.field_gauge: Whole-canvas fields only; common global phase inherited from iterative input; no independent local-factor stitching. Factor columns are not identified physical modes or calibrated posterior covariance.

optimization.training_loss: mean((predicted_normalized_intensity - raw_target*visible_alpha)^2), with family-balanced scan sampling and equal budget sampling. No target-dependent pixel weights or square-root transform.
optimization.checkpoint_selection: Lowest arithmetic mean of scan-level relative intensity RMSE over TP1/TP2 x three budgets; ties earliest; include untrained step0. Select each seed/model separately, no seed selection or ensemble in primary comparison.
optimization.test_time_adaptation: None after the common visible-only1000-epoch initial reconstruction. No target-family weights or gains fitted from query values.

metrics.primary: Per-scan sqrt(sum_query_pixels((Ihat-I)^2)/sum_query_pixels(I^2)); equal mean over LFP and NCM and equal mean over the3budgets. Also show every scan/budget and every seed; no dropping failures.
secondary: relative error of total detector fluence
annular and sector integrated intensity prediction in detector-pixel frequency units
forward runtime, initialization runtime, training compute, peak allocated memory
metrics.uncertainty: Two held-out families do not support a population-level significance claim. Spatial block resampling, if used, is conditional within scan; seeds and detector pixels are not independent specimens.
metrics.detector_integrals: Concentric radii [0,.125,.25,.5,sqrt(.5)] on centered fftfreq coordinates, and8equalangularsectors. Same raw recorded intensities; derived correlated endpoints, not independent material properties.

mathematics.moment_identity: E[|a*x|^2|Y]=a*E[xx*|Y]a for known linear complex field operator and conditional second moment. PSD factorization is prior art.
mathematics.noise_condition: If E[epsilon_q|x,Y,P]=0, squared prediction against disjoint noisy observations differs from clean expected intensity risk by a parameter-independent term. Archive preprocessing and full-scan calibrated P do not establish this condition; empirical recorded-measurement prediction is the unconditional claim.
mathematics.nonidentifiability: Only the measurement span of M is supervised. Factor unitaries and unsensed Gram directions remain ambiguous. No covariance calibration, unique object modes, or transport-property inference follows.
mathematics.gradient: For summed squared intensity residual, complex real-loss gradient is4 sum A*(residual * A B).

baseline_strengthening: All24 standard tasks receive a new fixed5000-epoch from-constant comparison because training-side losses still decrease; retain1000 and all historical outputs. No query-based iteration count selection.
implementation: New source modules will be checked on generated arrays and profiled on training inputs. Hash the final code, cached inputs and this contract in a separate execution freeze before training; scientific choices cannot be silently overwritten.

preserved_evidence.M3_official100: fixed completed assessment, never reused as fresh blind selection
